data.body: RECURRING LOCAL-ENV ISSUE (3rd occurrence, 2026-08-13): the hourly rebar-dev-update LaunchAgent produces PARTIAL installs when a command catches it mid-window — observed missing pydantic_ai submodules (occurrence 1), ImportError commit_impact (2, earwig), missing src/rebar/llm/failure.py entirely (3, despotic S3 close). Each silently breaks every close on this host until the next sync. Workaround (standing rule): always use the worktree venv (env PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH). Durable fix idea for the operator: make the updater install atomically — build into a staging venv and swap symlinks, so the global rebar is never observable mid-install. The updater is machine-local (docs/local-env-main-tracking.local.md), so this is an operator decision, not a repo ticket.
